disambiguation: It manages synchronization scope for plugins across devices, not general file management or plugin development.
extras: Free under MIT license, but requires paid Obsidian Sync subscription. Independent community project.
intentEvidence: Choose which Obsidian plugins can sync on your computers, phone, and iPad.
problem: Standard Obsidian Sync synchronizes all vault data, making it difficult to selectively sync or exclude specific plugins across multiple devices.
summary: Manages which Obsidian plugins sync across different devices (computers, phones, iPads) using Obsidian Sync, allowing granular control over sync scope.
